description: SigParser builds a database of contacts, companies, and relationship metrics from your team's email and calendar interactions. Use it in ChatGPT to find who you know at a company, see which coworker has the warmest relationship with a prospect, prepare pre-meeting company briefs, find dormant relationships worth re-engaging, export filtered contact lists to CSV, update contact and company records, and push contacts to your connected CRM or email marketing app.

defaultPrompt: Show me all the contacts we have at Acme that we have known for more than 1 year.
Find contacts in New York that work in Law Practice with interactions within the past 3 months that I can invite to our event.
Help me target clients that we should follow up with.
